definitions.gloss: various theories; multiple accounts; different opinions
definitions.explanation: A collection of different theories, opinions, or explanations about a topic. Often used to indicate that the truth is uncertain or debated.

examples.japanese: {語源|ごげん}には{諸説|しょせつ}ある。
examples.english: There are various theories about the etymology.

examples.japanese: {諸説|しょせつ}あるが、{最|もっと}も{有力|ゆうりょく}なのはこの{説|せつ}だ。
examples.english: There are various theories, but this one is the most credible.

examples.japanese: この{遺跡|いせき}の{年代|ねんだい}については{諸説|しょせつ}{紛々|ふんぷん}で、{未|いま}だに{定説|ていせつ}がない。
examples.english: There are many conflicting theories about the age of these ruins, and no established view yet.

notes: Very frequently appears in the set phrase {諸説|しょせつ}あり or {諸説|しょせつ}ある (there are various theories), used as a disclaimer when presenting information that is not definitively established. {諸説|しょせつ}{紛々|ふんぷん} means "opinions/theories are in wild disagreement." The prefix {諸|しょ} means "various/many" and appears in other compounds like {諸国|しょこく} (various countries) and {諸問題|しょもんだい} (various problems).
